sources.name: FLEURS (google/fleurs)
sources.evidence: Dataset card front matter 'license: cc-by-4.0' and 'All datasets are licensed under the Creative Commons license (CC-BY)', at revision 70bb2e84b976b7e960aa89f1c648e09c59f894dd.
sources.attribution: FLEURS, Google. Conneau et al., 'FLEURS: Few-shot Learning Evaluation of Universal Representations of Speech', 2022 (arXiv:2205.12446). Licensed under CC BY 4.0. Audio was resampled/normalised; no other changes.

sources.name: NTREX-128 (MicrosoftTranslator/NTREX)
sources.evidence: README: 'The NTREX-128 data set is released under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license'; GitHub licence detection reports CC-BY-SA-4.0, at commit 468c6b69c7f6a75d31d4743d9daba2af566cc18d.
sources.attribution: NTREX-128, Microsoft. Federmann, Kocmi and Xin, 'NTREX-128 - News Test References for MT Evaluation of 128 Languages', 2022; based on WMT19 newstest2019 (Barrault et al., 2019). CC BY-SA 4.0. Sentences are used unchanged as MT test data.

sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice Scripted Speech 27.0 - Spanish (local archive)
sources.evidence: Dataset page on Mozilla Data Collective: CC0-1.0 (as stated by the user's download; archive cv-corpus-27.0-2026-09-11-es.tar, 55,738,360,832 bytes). Used from the local archive; no API.
sources.terms: No re-hosting or re-sharing; no attempt to identify speakers. Nothing leaves the local cache; no audio is committed. Speaker ids in the manifest are salted hashes of client_id.
sources.attribution: Mozilla Common Voice contributors. CC0 1.0. Only the test split is used, and only clips whose self-reported accent is a Spain variety.
